*Dataset*  Records for all carriers/brokers/freight forwarders with active, inactive, or pending authorities (common or contract). It includes the DOT number and MC/FF/MX number for the carrier/broker/freight forwarder, along with company census data (e.g., types of authority, address, types of insurance on file, and amounts of insurance on file). 
Note: This dataset was last refreshed on 05/14/20
